description: This file defines an interface `IStorageManager` in the namespace `WPEFramework::Exchange`. The interface declares several pure virtual functions related to storage management, such as creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage for applications. It uses C++ features like virtual inheritance and enum. The file contains documentation comments and includes licensing information.

classes.name: IStorageManager
classes.description: An interface for managing application storage, providing methods for create, get, delete, and clear storage.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for a specified application ID with a given size, returning the storage path or an error reason.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the storage location for a given application ID, including size and used space metrics.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage for a specified application ID, providing an error reason if necessary.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage for a given application ID, including device storage.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all application storage except for exempted app IDs, provided in JSON format.
